description:
[narrowed from host-independent-federation-join-broken] FALSIFIER (closure predicate): on a substrate with no relay and no reachable hub -- (a) federation-transport-vessel is `active` not `activating` for >10min; (b) GET /bootstrap returns a non-empty discovery_endpoint and a non-loopback identity_endpoint under a foreign Host header; (c) an unreachable HUB_DISCOVERY_URL does not exit the transport process; (d) vesselRegistry shows >0 vessels carrying a libp2p_multiaddr. || EVIDENCE (live probe 2026-09-12, substrate-live, up 2d healthy): (1) federation-transport-vessel `activating`, restart counter 23; journal 'bootstrap fetch failed: The operation timed out' then hard exit at scripts/substrate/federation-relay/federation-transport-server.ts:61. Cause -- /workspace/.substrate-secrets pins HUB_DISCOVERY_URL=http://138.197.116.56:18100 and the unit loads it AFTER /etc/substrate/env, so a host-workspace file outranks substrate env; that IP returns HTTP 000 after 6s, while local /bootstrap answers 200 in 0.7ms from inside the same container. (2) GET /bootstrap = {relay_multiaddrs:[], identity_endpoint:'http://127.0.0.1:8101', discovery_endpoint:''}, unchanged under Host: hub.example.net -- the one public join door hands a joiner the joiner's own loopback. (3) Bootstrap is circular: discovery derives relay_multiaddrs from registered circuit multiaddrs (repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts:164-170), circuits require a transport, the transport exits without an anchor -- so a standalone substrate can never originate an overlay. Direct-dial announce code already exists (transport :326,:524,:647 'direct == punchthrough') but is unreachable behind that exit. (4) vesselRegistry: all 13 registered vessels have libp2p_multiaddr=null and loopback endpoints, so discovery's peer dialability filter (index.ts:267-274) would drop every one. (5) Registration replication and the /bootstrap loopback refusal ratified in openspec/changes/2026-07-19-relay-findability-replication never landed (grep replicat|forwardRegister|propagat over repos/discovery-vessel/src: no matches). || REPAIR: openspec/changes/2026-09-12-host-independent-federation-join/proposal.md -- 5 ordered steps, each with a check that fails today: (1) ungate transport startup on a missing relay, re-acquire a circuit on backoff and refresh the hub mirror on acquisition; (2) make /bootstrap anchors request-derived, never loopback/empty; (3) stop a host-workspace file outranking substrate env for routing anchors, degrade a dead hub hint to local discovery; (4) symmetric dialability so hub vessels carry circuits like spokes do; (5) registration replication so dialing in IS being findable.

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- verify_failed: src/index.ts(202,55): error TS2367: This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '"vesselCapability" | "vesselEndpoint" | "vesselHealth" | "vesselRegistry"' and '"relay_multiaddrs"' h
- semantic_reject: The patch only adds 'relay_multiaddrs' to DISCOVERY_SHAPES but doesn't address the core issues of loopback endpoints, hub discovery, or transport process behavior
- verify_failed: src/index.ts(213,9): error TS2367: This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '"vesselCapability" | "vesselEndpoint" | "vesselHealth" | "vesselRegistry"' and '"relay_multiaddrs"' ha

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
